# Story 8.3: E2E test for numeric column right-alignment

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a user (Dave),
I want an end-to-end proof that numbers in every table are right-aligned,
So that I can trust the alignment holds in real use across all table surfaces — not just in unit tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A Playwright e2e spec loads a table surface with seeded numeric data (open-positions or global-universe) and asserts that a numeric column's body cell content sits at the right edge of its cell: for a sampled row, the rendered value element's bounding box right edge is within a small tolerance of the `<mat-cell>`'s content-box right edge.
2. The same spec asserts a non-numeric (text) column in that table is NOT right-aligned — its content starts at the left edge — proving the alignment is type-driven, not global.
3. The spec runs on chromium alongside the existing e2e specs (`open-positions.spec.ts`, `dividend-deposits-modal.spec.ts`) with no pre-existing regression.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1: Add the e2e right-alignment spec (AC: #1, #2)
  - [ ] 1.1 In a new spec under `apps/dms-material-e2e/src/` (or alongside existing table specs), load open-positions or global-universe with seeded data and locate a numeric column's `<mat-cell>` (via `[data-column]`) for a sampled row.
  - [ ] 1.2 Assert the cell content's bounding box is right-aligned (content right edge ≈ cell content-box right edge, within tolerance).
  - [ ] 1.3 Assert a text column in the same table is left-aligned (content left edge ≈ cell content-box left edge).
- [ ] Task 2: Verify no regression (AC: #3)
  - [ ] 2.1 Run the new spec plus `open-positions.spec.ts` and `dividend-deposits-modal.spec.ts` on chromium; all pass.

## Dev Notes

- This is the user-visible proof for Story 8.2's centralized change. Because the fix lives in the shared `dms-base-table`, one e2e spec against a single surface (open-positions or global-universe) demonstrates the behavior that applies to every table; the other surfaces are covered by their existing specs passing unchanged.
- **Selector strategy:** use `[data-column="<field>"]` on `<mat-cell>` (already present in base-table) plus the row's `.dms-body-row`; read `getBoundingClientRect()` of both the cell and its inner value element to compare edges. Avoid asserting exact pixel values — use a small tolerance (a few px) for "at the edge."
- **Which columns:** pick a clearly numeric column (`quantity` or a currency column like `buy`) and a clearly text column (`symbol`). Do not assert on date columns here (that is Epic 9's concern).
- **Seeding:** reuse the existing e2e seed/fixture approach used by `open-positions.spec.ts`; do not introduce new DB setup.

### Project Structure Notes

- Add: one new spec file under `apps/dms-material-e2e/src/`. No production code changes in this story.
- No conflict: additive e2e spec; it does not modify app source or existing specs.
